# Licensing inventory

- `../LICENSE` and `Apache-2.0.txt`: project license text.
- `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`: exact default-build inventory and optional-adapter warning.
- `MODEL_LICENSES.json`: machine-readable per-model/artifact status.

No model or selected upstream source closure may be added without updating these files, the SPDX manifest, provenance ledger, and release evidence. This inventory is not legal advice.
